title: 2026 Holiday Tree Trail
seo_title: 2026 Holiday Tree Trail in Joplin, MO – Dec 3
description: The 2026 Holiday Tree Trail is an outdoor holiday event featuring Christmas trees decorated by local organizations and businesses, where you can vote for your favorite tree. There is also hot chocolate, a visit from Santa Claus, and music and dancing. It takes place on December 3, 2026 (Time TBD) at 3002 Saint Johns Blvd in Joplin, MO.
